problems.title: Incomplete Enrollment Transaction
problems.scenario: A student is enrolling in multiple subjects. An error occurs while processing one of the subjects.

problems.title: Last Available Slot
problems.scenario: A section has only one remaining slot, and two enrollment requests arrive at almost the same time. Requests may be entered by students or by registrar staff.

problems.title: Duplicate Enrollment
problems.scenario: The same enrollment request is submitted twice, either accidentally or through simultaneous requests.

problems.title: Incorrect Section Capacity
problems.scenario: The number of enrolled students and the section's maximum capacity become inconsistent, or a stored enrollment count is incorrect.

problems.title: Simultaneous Student Updates
problems.scenario: Two authorized users, such as two registrars, attempt to modify the same student's enrollment information at the same time.

problems.title: Enrollment Cancellation
problems.scenario: A student cancels an enrollment containing several subjects, either through an online request or with registrar assistance.

problems.title: Database Deadlock
problems.scenario: Two transactions need multiple records or resources but acquire them in different orders.

problems.title: Student Search Performance
problems.scenario: The school has thousands of student records, and searching for a student becomes slower as the database grows.

problems.title: Enrollment History Performance
problems.scenario: The school has hundreds of thousands of enrollment records, and the registrar needs to retrieve a student's complete enrollment history.

problems.title: Concurrent Subject Registration
problems.scenario: Several enrollment requests for different students target the same popular subject or section at the same time.

problems.title: Invalid Enrollment Data
problems.scenario: An enrollment record contains invalid or incomplete information, such as a non-existent student, non-existent subject, invalid section, or missing required information.

problems.title: Prerequisite Checking
problems.scenario: A student attempts to enroll in a subject without completing its prerequisite. The request may be handled online or by registrar staff.

problems.title: Maximum Academic Load
problems.scenario: A student attempts to enroll in subjects whose combined units exceed the school's maximum allowed academic load.

problems.title: Faculty Teaching Load
problems.scenario: A faculty member is assigned to sections that exceed the school's allowed teaching load. If your system does not manage faculty assignments, explain this limitation.

problems.title: Conflicting Class Schedules
problems.scenario: A student attempts to enroll in two subjects with overlapping schedules.

problems.title: Transaction Failure During Enrollment
problems.scenario: One database operation fails before the full enrollment process is complete.

problems.title: Power Interruption During Enrollment
problems.scenario: A student or registrar staff member submits an enrollment request, but the electricity suddenly goes out before the process is completed. The outage may affect the user's computer, the school network, or the database server.

problems.title: Duplicate Student ID
problems.scenario: Two staff members accidentally register different students using the same Student ID, either at different times or at almost the same time.

problems.title: Accidental Deletion
problems.scenario: A staff member accidentally deletes a student's enrollment record.

problems.title: Reports During Active Enrollment
problems.scenario: The dean generates an enrollment report while the registrar is still enrolling students.

problems.title: Database Recovery
problems.scenario: The database server unexpectedly fails while enrollment transactions are being processed.

problems.title: Unauthorized Database Access
problems.scenario: Different roles may include student, faculty, registrar, and administrator. Your actual roles may differ.

problems.title: Heavy Enrollment Traffic
problems.scenario: Enrollment opens at a scheduled time, and many users or registrar staff access the system simultaneously.

problems.title: Complete Enrollment-Day Challenge
problems.scenario: It is enrollment day. Many students access the system; multiple requests target the same section; some requests are duplicates, fail prerequisite or load checks, or conflict with registrar updates. Some transactions fail, and the database contains hundreds of thousands of enrollment records. Adapt the scenario to your system's actual workflow.

presentation.title: Transactions
items: At least one meaningful transaction (Can also use Try and Catch method)
A failure scenario and the observed result

presentation.title: ACID Properties
items: Isolation (Like the Use of FOR and UPDATE)
Durability (Must have a Backup Way or Method)

presentation.title: Deadlock
items: Prevention or handling strategy; a controlled demonstration or explanation if the application does not naturally produce one

presentation.title: Indexing
items: Query plan or performance evidence where feasible

presentation.title: Testing
items: Screenshot, SQL output, logs, or other evidence

presentation.title: Workflow and Applicability
items: Explain whether enrollment is student-initiated, registrar-assisted, walk-in, or a combination
Identify problems marked N/A or partially applicable and justify each decision
Describe an equivalent test or design where needed
